test_title: PYST 45: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 31 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All pencils are erasers.

All pens are erasers.

All erasers are scales.

**Conclusions:**

I. All pens are scales.

II. All erasers are pencils.

III. Some erasers are pens.

options.text: Only conclusion I and II follow
Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and III follow

solution: The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80562182762002c3caef333f6cfea851aae2cb7b5493ba5c79a88f8cf063b2c7.png] Conclusions: I. All pens are scales → **Follow** (As, all pens are erasers and all erasers are scales. So, as whole pens comes in erasers which whole comes in scales, therefore it is definitely true.)
